edit.expected: Starting to edit id 7 sets state.editing to that id.

save.expected: Saving id 7 with a padded nonempty title trims its title and exits editing.

cancel.expected: Cancelling edit keeps the original title and exits editing.

clear.expected: Clearing completed todos leaves only id 7.

route.expected: The completed route is recorded in the state filter.

filtered-view.expected: Selecting the completed route shows only the completed item.

initial-state.expected: Empty list, all filter, no editing, and numeric nextId when storage is empty.

restore.expected: Initialize from the two ordered {id,title,completed} records in react-todos. Preserve their values.

append.expected: Add a trimmed third active item with an unused ID; retain the two earlier items.

blank.expected: Ignore a whitespace-only title without changing the two existing todos.

persist.expected: After adding Third note, react-todos contains three ordered records with id,title,completed; no editing state in the stored array.

view.expected: View lists both items in order and reports hasTodos true, allCompleted false, hasCompleted true, editing null, filter all.

empty-view.expected: For an empty state, visible is empty and hasTodos is false.

count.expected: With one active item the countText is 1 item left.
